notes.title: Update for Sept 2021
notes.notes:
Minor Bug Fixes. 

- Music can now be toggled on/off using the mouse
- The continue button now works again using the mouse

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes: The player with now only jump once and will not continually jump while holding down the jump button.  This was changed to fix a bug where the player would at times unintentionally double jump though platforms.
